died.name: Abraham Lincoln
died.cause: assuring his wife Mary that their friend Clara would not mind them holding hands, shortly before he was fatally shot from behind
died.last_words: She won't think anything about it.

died.name: Father Damien
died.desc: SS.CC., Belgian Roman Catholic priest, minister to people with leprosy in the Hawaiian Kingdom
died.last_words: Well! God's will be done. He knows best. My work, with all its faults and failures, is in His hands, and before Easter I shall see my Saviour.

died.name: Thomas Andrews
died.cause: the naval architect of the Titanic, designed his famous vessel while serving as the managing director and head of the drafting department of the shipbuilding company Harland and Wolff in Belfast, Ireland. He was aboard the Titanic during her maiden voyage and perished alongside approximately 1,500 others when the ship hit an iceberg and sank on 14 April 1912. Andrews' body was never recovered.

died.name: Jane Delano
died.desc: American nurse, founder of the American Red Cross Nursing Service
died.cause: dying while on a Red Cross mission in France
died.last_words: I must get back to my work.

died.name: Jean-Paul Sartre
died.cause: to his partner, Simone de Beauvoir
died.last_words: I love you very much, my dear Beaver.

died.name: Kenneth Williams
died.cause: the last words he wrote in his diary

born.name: Leonardo da Vinci
born.cause: to King Francis I of France
born.last_words: I have offended God and mankind because my work did not reach the quality it should have.

born.name: William Cullen
born.last_words: I wish I had the power of writing, for then I would describe to you how pleasant a thing it is to die.

born.name: John Lothrop Motley
born.last_words: I am ill - very ill, I shall not recover.

born.name: Jim Creighton

born.last_words: I'm a dead man, see ya.
